title: Libre 2 plus / 2+  C6 sensor not recognised. Patchinfo 0xC60931
symptom: A UK Libre 2 plus sensor is not recognised; patchinfo reports as C6 09 31.
fix: Use the xDrip release of June 11, 2024 or any one after that.
evidence_quote: Please use the xDrip release of June 11, 2024 or any one after that and if the problem persists, please tell us.
